messages:
Maya (docs): heads up — i'm opening a small PR to reconcile wording around audit-log exports and retention exceptions. ran into an edge case re: exports for legal-hold vs normal retention. 
Sam (security): thanks. can you drop the PR link? want to sanity-check the threat model language. :shield:
Maya (docs): sure — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4523 — main change is a short paragraph under `audit exports` clarifying that exported JSONL will reflect current redaction state, and that legal-hold bypass is an internal process, not exposed in the export metadata.
Jon (legal): quick note — we should avoid implying that exports can be used to evade retention controls. suggested phrasing: "Exports provide a point-in-time copy of retained audit events; retention policies and legal holds are enforced before export generation."
Priya (docs): love that. small nit: can we add an example snippet showing expected JSONL header and a brief example redaction field so users know what to expect?
Liam (eng): i can paste a typical header from the export job. sample: ```{"export_id":"exp_2024_09_01","scope":"org","generated_by":"export-service","redaction_applied":true}```
Maya (docs): perfect. i'm also adding two short bullets about: 1) when exports might contain more rows than UI view due to granular retention filters and 2) how to request re-run with legal-hold flag (internal only).
Sam (security): language looks fine. one request: explicitly state that exported files are delivered to the customer's configured storage and we do not modify customer-delivered artifacts post-export. avoid "we may redact later" phrasing.
Jon (legal): agreed. also add a line instructing customers to contact support with legal hold requests — don't publish internal ops instructions.
Priya (docs): suggest this wording for the retention section: "Retention policies are evaluated at export time; events excluded by an active retention rule will not be present in exported artifacts. For legal holds, consult your account team to initiate preservation workflows."
Maya (docs): thanks — i'll update the PR with both the snippet and that phrasing. will ping @Sam and @Jon for final sign-off.
docs-bot: PR 4523 updated by maya — changed files: audit-exports.md, retention.md ; link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4523/files
Liam (eng): minor tech note: export pipeline marks redaction_version in metadata, maybe add that field to example header: ```"redaction_version":"v2"``` so customers can map to SDK behavior.
Maya (docs): good call. adding that.
Sam (security): one last thought — add a short line about retention TTL vs backups: "backups are independent and may have different retention; contact support for backup retention requests."
Maya (docs): done in draft. i'll merge after Jon approves. thanks team :thumbsup:
Jon (legal): approved from legal. go ahead. :white_check_mark:
Maya (docs): merged. closing thread.
